cases.note: dss_capi 0.14.5 has no WindGen (#263 'Object Type WindGen not found'), while dss_capi 0.15.0b4 / SVN r4103 compiles+solves this deck (probed 2026-07-17: converged, 281 nodes, 244 elements). Blocker: the deck is a MULTI-STEP dynamics run (snapshot solve, then `set mode=dynamics stepsize=0.001 number=200/70/2000` with a fault at bus 51, plus `BatchEdit Load..* Daily=default` loadshapes). The dss_capi channel cannot gate a multi-step deck: oracle_server.run_case's per-step capture re-nominalizes time-varying elements (loads/shapes read their step-0/nominal value while dbl_hour advances), and the harness n_steps=1 solve here lands mid-dynamics (dbl_hour advanced to ~0.00119). WindGen also carries a daily Losses-staleness quirk in dss_capi (el.Losses cached across daily steps, see the windgen_daily note) that would diverge the full-model losses channel. WindGen snapshot/daily/dynamics coverage IS gated by the modes/windgen family (windgen_snap/_delta/_daily/_dyn/_dyn_fault) + the aerodynamic_wind_speed_sweep unit test. Promotable once the multi-step re-nominalization in oracle_server.py is fixed.

dss_capi 0.14.5 has no WindGen (#263 'Object Type WindGen not found'), while dss_capi 0.15.0b4 / SVN r4103 compiles+solves this deck (probed 2026-07-17: converged, 281 nodes, 244 elements). Blocker: MULTI-STEP QSTS run, a snapshot solve then `set mode=daily number=24` over a WindData daily loadshape (the shape supplies wind SPEED) plus `BatchEdit Load..* Daily=default`. The dss_capi channel cannot gate a multi-step deck: run_case's per-step capture re-nominalizes time-varying elements, so a daily deck reports the nominal step-0 state every step, and the harness n_steps=1 solve advances to dbl_hour=48. Plus the WindGen daily Losses-staleness quirk (see the windgen_daily note) would diverge the full-model losses channel. WindGen daily/dynamics/snapshot coverage IS gated by the modes/windgen family + the aerodynamic_wind_speed_sweep unit test. Promotable once the multi-step re-nominalization in oracle_server.py is fixed.
